assertions.assertion: Implements IExtensionGrantValidator with the GrantType set to 'urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange'
assertions.rationale: TokenExchangeGrantValidator implements IExtensionGrantValidator and sets GrantType => "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange".

assertions.assertion: Extracts and validates the subject_token from the request
assertions.rationale: Reads subject_token from context.Request.Raw and validates it with _tokenValidator.ValidateAccessTokenAsync.

assertions.assertion: Returns a GrantValidationResult with a subject ID and custom claims array
assertions.rationale: Returns new GrantValidationResult(subject: subjectId, authenticationMethod: GrantType, claims: customClaims).

assertions.assertion: Registers the validator with AddExtensionGrantValidator<T>() on the IdentityServer builder
Mentions that IProfileService is called after the grant validator and can augment claims further
assertions.rationale: Explicitly states GetProfileDataAsync is called after the grant validator and can augment/filter the claims via AddRequestedClaims.
